subject: Pilot economics + latency trade-offs — confirm targets and next steps
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@clarityhealth.ai>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@clarityhealth.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot economics + latency trade-offs — confirm targets and next steps

Hi Sam / Alicia —

Thanks again for a productive call today. Quick recap and the asks we discussed so we can lock the pilot scope:

Summary of what you said:
- Core use: clinical note summarization + short Q&A layered over EMR extracts. Expect mixed interactive and batch traffic.
- Estimated profile: ~25M tokens/month in steady state for analytics, spiky interactive peaks during clinic hours (~3–5x baseline).
- Latency target: want p95 <= 300 ms for interactive flows; willing to accept p95 <= 800 ms for batched nightly jobs.
- Budget range: $3k–$8k/month for the pilot phase; eventual target for production ~ $12k–$25k/month depending on adoption.

Unit economics and trade-offs we discussed (initial assumptions):
- Target unit price you noted: $/1M tokens target around $700–$1,100 depending on latency SLO and discounting for committed volume.
- Streaming (low-latency) ~= 2–3x the unit cost of aggressive batching for equivalent tokens; multipath routing (stream for interactive, batch for offline) is how we'd balance cost.

Proposed pilot configuration (what Redwood would run for the trial):
- Duration: 6 weeks (2 week ramp + 4 week evaluation).
- Workload split: interactive ~30% tokens, batch ~70%.
- Routing: interactive -> latency tier (p95 target 250–350 ms) on smaller models or deduped cache path; batch -> high-throughput quantized model with aggressive batching.
- Economics: rough estimate based on your 25M/mo: $/1M tokens = $950 (interactive-heavy), blended to ~$760 with 70% batch. Committed pilot discount proposed: 20% off list for the 6-week trial evaluation.

Attachments: I attached a draft pilot scope and a simple SLO vs cost matrix for the three candidate tiers.

Asks / next steps:
1) Please confirm we captured the tokens/month and the interactive/batch split (if off, send corrected numbers).
2) Confirm whether the $3k–$8k pilot budget was per month or total for the 6-week pilot (I believe you meant per month, but want to be explicit).
3) If you want us to price an alternate where streaming is 50% of tokens, say so and we’ll return a delta.

I’ll loop in Ben and Vivek to check discounting/commit options once you confirm the numbers.

Best,
Stephanie
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- clarity-pilot-scope-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet — pilot tasks, success metrics)
- latency-vs-cost-slo-matrix.pdf (1 page)
From: Sam Park <sam.park@clarityhealth.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@clarityhealth.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot economics + latency trade-offs — confirm targets and next steps

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications below:

1) Tokens/month: the 25M number is a conservative midline for month 1 of the pilot. If the trial goes well adoption could bump that to ~40M/mo by month 3. For the pilot, planning number = 25M/mo.
2) Budget: the $3k–$8k band was intended as a monthly run-rate during the pilot (not total). Our procurement team wants a firm monthly estimate to tie to the POC cost center.
3) Traffic split: interactive will likely be closer to 40% of tokens during clinic hours, but averaged across 24/7 it’s roughly 35/65 interactive/batch. Peak multipliers are correct (3–4x).

On latency: p95 <= 300 ms is a hard ask for clinician-facing flows. If that requires a higher unit price we want visibility on the delta. For batch jobs we care mostly about throughput and cost; p95 up to 1s is acceptable.

Attached a simple traffic timeline (we’ll drop it into the pilot spreadsheet).

Sam
Director of Product
ClarityHealth
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 11:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot economics + latency trade-offs — confirm targets and next steps

Looping in internal pricing/strategy notes for the pilot. Key points:

- With their stated profile (25M/mo, 35% interactive), our blended list estimate (~$760 / 1M tokens) is reasonable but we can produce two clear options:
  A) Latency-priority pilot (p95 interactive <=300ms): blended $/1M = $920 (streaming percentage keeps cost up).
  B) Cost-priority pilot (aggressive batching + streaming only for strict UI calls): blended $/1M = $640.

- Discounting approach: for a 6-week pilot we can offer a time-limited pilot rate: 25% off option A or 30% off option B to keep them in budget bands. Those yield ~$690 /1M (option A pilot rate) and ~$448 /1M (option B pilot rate).

- If they aim for 40M/mo by month 3, we should present committed capacity pricing tiers (3–6 month commit) that further lower unit cost by another ~15–25% depending on model choice and quantization.

Action for us: can we produce a two-column quote (Latency-priority vs Cost-priority) with monthly totals at 25M and 40M token breakpoints? Stephanie, I can draft the numbers and legal can do a short pilot SOW.

Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@clarityhealth.ai>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@clarityhealth.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot economics + latency trade-offs — confirm targets and next steps

Thanks Sam — helpful clarifications. Next steps from Redwood side:

1) Ben will send a two-option commercial snapshot today (Latency-priority vs Cost-priority) at 25M and 40M monthly volumes including the pilot discount slices we discussed.
2) Vivek and I will model the expected p95 latency deltas and the cost delta for an alternate where interactive = 50% tokens (you asked for a 50% scenario). Expect a short note by EOD tomorrow.
3) I will update the pilot scope spreadsheet to mark the pilot budget as monthly and add your traffic timeline.

Sam / Alicia — can you confirm by end of day tomorrow whether you prefer Redwood to price the pilot as:
- Option A: prioritize interactive SLO (p95 <= 300 ms); or
- Option B: prioritize blended cost (lower $/1M) and accept p95 up to ~800–1000 ms on non-critical flows.

If neither, say the word and we’ll price a middle path (50% streaming split) — Ben flagged that will sit between the two quoted $/1M numbers.

Thanks — looking forward to locking dates once we land the budget.

Stephanie
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Quoted attachments referenced above.
